messages:
Tara (Product): Quick decision thread: we need firm launch criteria for Private deploys focused on packaging + upgrade consent flows. Specifically: SLA language, telemetry for rollback decisions, and legal guardrails.
Juan (Eng Runtime): For MVP we ship handshake consent + snapshot rollback. Questions: what signals trigger automatic rollback vs manual rollback? Need thresholds.
Mika (Field): Field request: automatic rollback ok for infra-level failures (process crash, failed healthcheck >60s). Customers want manual approval for config drift or peering breakage.
Noah (NetSec): Security/legal concern: if we auto-rollback because of routing changes, need a signed consent that we can revert BGP sessions or withdraw advertised prefixes. Legal needs explicit opt-in.
Tara (Product): Proposal: define 3 rollback classes:
 - class A: infra-critical (auto-rollback after 60s degraded + failed retries)
 - class B: network-affects (require operator confirm; but allow auto-safety actions like withdraw routes)
 - class C: semantic/config (always manual)
Juan (Eng Runtime): Implementation plan: telemetry exposes metrics: health.check.fail_count, kv.snapshot.integrity(boolean), route.flap_count. Rollback rule engine uses rule-set in manifest or console.
Mika (Field): Add acceptance criteria: during pilot (3 customers) we must observe <2 rollbacks triggered and successful snapshot restore within 15 minutes for class A events.
Priya (Customer Success): CS requirement: customer-facing consent flow + audit trail. They want a short plain-English clause to include in contracts: what Redwood can and cannot change during upgrade.
ops-bot: ops-bot: nightly-build-2025.11.09  smoke OK :white_check_mark:
Noah (NetSec): Legal bullet points we need:
 - explicit consent for IP withdrawal/reassignment
 - retention of audit logs for 1 year
 - SLA for rollback time for class A events
I'll open a legal ticket and attach sample language.
Tara (Product): Good. Also: manifest additions proposal: "rollback.policy" = "auto|semi-auto|manual", "rollback.triggers" = ["health_failure","kv_mismatch","route_loss"], "audit.log_destination".
Juan (Eng Runtime): CLI example: `rw-upgrade --manifest site.json --consent=consent-file.json`. Consent file contains fields: customer_signer, ip_withdrawal:true|false, audit_endpoint.
Mika (Field): Pilot plan: choose one cloud, one co-lo, one air-gapped. Tests: simulate degraded disk, simulate peer ASN mismatch, simulate BGP session drop and measure rollback behavior.
Priya (Customer Success): I'll draft the customer consent language and a one-page FAQ describing rollback classes and expectations. Target: draft by 2026-04-07.
Tara (Product): Owners/timeline: Legal ticket (Noah) by EOD, Eng rule-engine prototype (Juan) by 2026-04-15, Field pilots (Mika/Priya) start 2026-04-20, Docs (Priya/Sam) publish 2026-04-25.
Juan (Eng Runtime): Preflight checks to add: consent file validity, audit endpoint reachable, snapshot storage available, integrity checksum.
Noah (NetSec): I'll coordinate with Legal and Security for the consent schema. Also will add a mandatory flag for IP-withdrawal opt-in.
Tara (Product): If no objections by EOD Friday we'll freeze this scope for the MVP. Thanks everyone.
